# LUNAR LANDER - Stuart Croft - DREAMER 5 p.18 (PDF p.20)
# load 0080-03FF (printed range 0080-0400); CHIP-8 starts at 0200, run C000 FN 3
# how to play: screen shows FUEL (75), DIST (250) and RATE (75, minus = falling); a small LEM on the right
# shows progress. Each turn key a burn of 0-9 units. Landing at 0-3 units of speed is safe;
# burning 3 or less lets gravity accelerate the descent, burning too much makes you climb.
# Restart: "Key C000, FN, 3" (struck out by hand on the scan, with an "F" written below)
# Note: 0350 = 05F0 (machine-code call outside the program, printed clearly). On a 1K machine it
# mirrors to 01F0 (screen buffer); in the simulation (1K and 4K) both endings work anyway.
